Proves AR-6's `in` operator on a `date` field (AR-7) when the Set Filter's `values` use the zone-less `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` spelling at midnight (SEM-4, SEM-5; Bug #2319): the adapter resolves each value into a local calendar date (`dateValue`, no zone), so the artifacts are identical to case 050's, which spells the same members as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Per SQL-4 Postgres casts the set array, `"birth_date" = ANY($1::date[])`. A `date` field accepts only a midnight time; a non-midnight time is a `malformed-request` rejection (unit-tested, not a fixture, since it has no artifact). The neighbours one day either side of a member are not members; SEM-2: `in` never matches null.
